repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button != "pushed")
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve_open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a rising-edge wait for the button. The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only evaluates at the start of each 1-second iteration. Since the button was pushed at t=100ms (after the first iteration started), the candidate missed the event. The repair implements the rising-edge state machine: block until the signal drops, then block until it rises, then execute the body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a blocking two-wait rearming pattern (`wait until(not C)`, `wait until(C)`) to correctly detect the rising edge at t=100ms and repeat the action every 1 second thereafter.
